sources.notes: Road elevations are edited from NLS Elevation model 2 m ground raster (National Land Survey of Finland, Elevation model 2 m, delivered 2026-11-07, CC BY 4.0). Edited from the NLS Elevation model 2 m, distributed by CSC Paituli under CC BY4.0. Dataset delivered2026-11-07. Bilinear ground samples at paired road midpoints, compressed within0.25m of sampled values. Both deck and occluded lower road interpolate between their own separate ground approach endpoints, excluding interior ground cells. Heights and clearance are estimates, not a bridge survey. STAC sourceDatetime identifies the catalogue record, not an established flight date. No nominal deck height. The bridge uses explicit paired source stations; cross-sections never select another road branch. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations, not verified curb locations. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Borders retain their feature licences and unverified status. Imagery loads externally; no meshes, image bytes or videos are stored.

supersedes.reason: Original unequal edge station grids flatten the source-backed overpass. Replace with complete image-reviewed paired estimates and NLS ground approaches; replace incompatible coarse surrounding terrain with the same native source, retaining original borders, model and terrain in shared proof.

measurement.note: Road-edge estimates from51 labelled native-image control stations:35 visible cross-section reads and16 inferred shadow, branch-opening or occlusion joins, roughly1-2m reading precision. The lower crossing and deep-shadow portions use provisional inferred joins, not independent observations. Diagnostic gamma brightening preserves original pixel locations. Dense fitted controls interpolate normal offsets along the unchanged source path. The full overlay was compared with original imagery and georeferenced NLS2023 orthophoto corroboration; joins remain estimated and do not establish independently observed limits. No nominal width or official-length fit; curbs illustrative and banking unknown.

crossings.note: Selected source bridge20303307v12 layer1. Upper approach interval extends beyond both mapped bridge endpoints; lower road uses separate visible approaches. Source trace and timing remain unchanged. Both road levels ground-derived estimates, not surveyed clearance.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
